resources.string: Review collection consent and enable the two access routes in Settings.
Translate captured text on this device with ML Kit.

ML Kit processes alert text and translations on this device. Google may receive SDK usage and performance metrics and provide model updates. Model downloads need separate approval and Wi-Fi, around 30 MB per language. No CodeClear server translation is used. See developers.google.com/ml-kit/terms. This preview keeps results only in memory.
Prepare the language models to translate this alert locally.

Download the required ML Kit models over Wi-Fi, around 30 MB per language. Translation text stays on this device. If Wi-Fi is unavailable, the SDK may wait for it. A pending SDK download cannot be cancelled by this preview; late results are discarded when the selected alert or target changes.
